title: A generative approach for improving multi-label defect classification in photovoltaic modules (Generative Defect Isolation)
mechanism: Remove selected defects from EL images with LaMa inpainting guided by the annotation masks, producing single-defect and defect-free training samples (subtractive rather than additive augmentation).
adaptation: For labelled crack cells, inpaint chosen crack components (mask dilated to cover the ~4 px dark line + 3 px) and relabel background, keeping other defects; also remove inactive while keeping its crack. Never remove a crack while keeping its inactive. Creates exact-location hard negatives, the counter to CP100's decoys.
min_experiment: Pre-check: 30 inpainted cells inspected, house ensemble p(crack) on inpainted spots < 0.1. Then PF+GDI vs PF, 5 seeds; test crack relP@2 and IoU, false crack px on val, E1 relF1@2. Kill: relP@2 < +0.01 and crack IoU < +0.012.
evidence: UCF-EL multi-label classification: beat mask-exact random copy-paste on 3 backbones; copy-paste dropped EfficientNetV2-L F1 0.767 to 0.746, GDI raised it to 0.774; rare-class F1 up to +63.6%.
prior_overlap: none; defect removal never tried. CP100 (additive paste onto pool cells) is the opposite operation.

alt_notes.adaptation: Fine-tune LaMa on pool cells, then (a) inpaint inactive regions to normal brightness to make crack-only twins, breaking the 'inactive never without crack' coupling, and (b) inpaint cracks out to make clean negatives with identical context; masks edited accordingly.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + inpainted twins (1:1). Baseline: house, 5 v 5 seeds. Metrics: test inactive IoU, crack precision. Kill if inactive IoU < +0.02 and crack pixel precision flat.

alt_notes.adaptation: Erase 3 to 5 px dilated crack masks (and, separately, inactive regions) in the 209 crack train cells to make paired clean twins with relabelled masks; train on originals plus twins to sharpen crack v decoy decisions and decouple crack from inactive.
alt_notes.min_experiment: Arm: house + paired LaMa twins. Baseline: house, 5 seeds. Metric: crack relP@2 and crack IoU. Kill if relP@2 < +0.01 and IoU < +0.012.

alt_notes.adaptation: Inpaint the crack label dilated 3 px on the 209 crack cells (and inactive on 42) to make crack-free twins: paired hard negatives sharing every decoy, clean canvases for procedural or generated cracks drawn at a known place (labels aligned by construction), and crack-only / inactive-only variants for the argmax conflict. Verify no dark residue (house p(crack) < 0.01 inside old mask).
alt_notes.min_experiment: PF + 209 twins as in-batch paired negatives vs PF. Metric test crack relP@2 and E1 false-positive px per cell; guard relR@2. Kill: relP@2 gain < +0.01 with relR@2 drop > 0.01. Second arm: procedural crack on twins, kill if E1 relF1@2 gain < +0.02.

alt_notes.adaptation: Inpaint dilated crack labels on the 209 crack cells (inactive on 42) to make crack-free twins: paired hard negatives with identical decoys, clean canvases for procedural cracks at known places (aligned by construction), and crack-only / inactive-only variants for the argmax conflict. Check no dark residue.
alt_notes.min_experiment: PF + 209 twins paired in batch vs PF. Metric test crack relP@2 and E1 crack FP px per cell, guard relR@2. Kill: relP@2 < +0.01 with relR@2 drop > 0.01. Second arm procedural cracks on twins, kill E1 relF1@2 < +0.02. About 8 GPU-h.
